# GAEP Product × Capability Decision Guide

Use this generated guide to inspect all 450 evidence-bounded cells without opening raw JSON. It is bound to GAEP-REG-013 v0.2.1, research as-of 2026-08-08.

> **Decision boundary:** there is no universal winner or aggregate score. Product support, delivery, evidence freshness, limitations, and scenario fit remain separate. GAEP maturity describes this repository only and never changes a market cell.

> **Unknown rule:** Unknown means no active reviewed assertion established support for this Product/capability cell. It is not “No,” “unsupported,” or evidence of absence.

[Return to the main GAEP Guide](./GAEP_GUIDE.md#market-and-capability-decision-support)

## Executive category and scenario frame

The registry covers 9 market categories and 7 adoption scenarios. Start with the job, required evidence, fit/non-fit boundary, stewardship capacity, and a predeclared proof-of-value measure; then inspect cell evidence below.

<details>
<summary><strong>Show category definitions</strong></summary>

- **GAEP-CAT-001 · Governed Product-to-Operations decision and evidence system** — Maintains governed Product and Initiative truth, human authority, traceability, and lifecycle evidence across Product-to-Operations decisions.
- **GAEP-CAT-002 · Specification-driven development toolkit or IDE** — Structures requirements, design, tasks, and implementation around versioned specifications.
- **GAEP-CAT-003 · AI coding and engineering agent** — Reads or changes code and executes bounded engineering tasks through an agentic interface.
- **GAEP-CAT-004 · Repository-native DevSecOps platform** — Combines repository, planning, CI/CD, security, and delivery controls around software repositories.
- **GAEP-CAT-005 · Product discovery and requirements platform** — Captures product intent, evidence, priorities, requirements, and roadmaps before or alongside delivery.
- **GAEP-CAT-006 · Enterprise architecture and transformation platform** — Maintains connected business, application, technology, and transformation architecture information.
- **GAEP-CAT-007 · Engineering or application lifecycle management platform** — Connects requirements, changes, tests, configurations, and evidence across complex engineering lifecycles.
- **GAEP-CAT-008 · Product design and developer handoff platform** — Supports collaborative product design, design systems, prototypes, and implementation handoff.
- **GAEP-CAT-009 · Enterprise business application** — Runs operational business processes rather than governing how software products are conceived and engineered.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Show scenario fit and non-fit boundaries</strong></summary>

- **GAEP-SCN-001 · Product and executive governance** — fit: Need durable Product/Initiative evidence and human decision separation Non-fit: Need is only code completion
- **GAEP-SCN-002 · Product and business architecture** — fit: Need trace from discovery into capability/value/operating models Non-fit: A simple roadmap is sufficient
- **GAEP-SCN-003 · Enterprise and software architecture** — fit: Need architecture decisions and cross-system impact Non-fit: Static diagrams alone satisfy the need
- **GAEP-SCN-004 · Engineering delivery** — fit: Need implementation agents tied to upstream context Non-fit: Team only needs a single coding assistant
- **GAEP-SCN-005 · Regulated or evidence-sensitive environments** — fit: Need exact evidence, audit history, and human authority boundaries Non-fit: No organization can assign required authorities
- **GAEP-SCN-006 · Teams seeking only an AI coding assistant** — fit: Need code changes, tests, and review in existing repositories Non-fit: Need a new Product governance operating model
- **GAEP-SCN-007 · Teams seeking a full Product-to-Operations governance system** — fit: Need cross-functional governed truth and evidence across the lifecycle Non-fit: No capacity exists for stewardship, review, or explicit authority

</details>
